summary:
Astro Flow is an advanced, automated biomedical hardware system designed to replace traditional manual blood pressure-infusion cuffs and eliminate critical clinical risks such as air embolism, vein collapse, and overpressure trauma. Powered by an Arduino Uno microcontroller, the system integrates dual HX711 24-bit ADC modules connected to a weight-sensing load cell and an air pressure sensor to monitor live fluid levels and cuff pressure dynamically.
​As the blood bag empties, SmartFlow automatically adjusts its target pressure across four calibrated tiers, scaling from 100 mmHg up to 280 mmHg to ensure a consistent, safe flow. Safety is strictly enforced through a hard cut-off mechanism that instantly opens a solenoid air-vent valve if pressure reaches or exceeds 300 mmHg. The system also features a 16x2 I2C LCD displaying live metrics, non-blocking variable-speed buzzer alerts for low blood volumes, a 10-second final flush countdown, and an emergency override push button. By automating fluid delivery with closed-loop precision, SmartFlow drastically enhances patient safety during emergency trauma care.
details: Astro Flow is an automated biomedical infusion system designed for microgravity space environments to prevent air embolism, vein collapse, and overpressure trauma. Powered by an Arduino Uno, it uses dual HX711 sensors to monitor blood bag weight and cuff pressure dynamically. As the bag empties, it scales target pressure (100–280 mmHg) and features a hard safety cut-off at 300 mmHg, a 16x2 LCD display, non-blocking buzzer alerts, a final flush countdown, and an emergency override switch to ensure safe trauma care in space.
